mostWorthwhile.text: Following metal droplets as gravity concentrates them into a core made differentiation easy to picture, while acknowledging that several pathways are possible.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final crust sequence felt somewhat repetitive because each step offered only one combination, though it explained cooling clearly.

surprise.text: I was struck that convection brings heat to the surface to escape, allowing crystals to form while hot rock remains below.

arbitrary.text: Combining the crystals with hot melt to make rafts was less intuitive than the preceding cooling step; I followed the only offered combination.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how later impacts and upwelling remake the fragile crust, especially after the clear explanation of its formation.
